SELECT
    JL."BPLId" AS "BPLId",
    BR."BPLName" AS "BPLName",
    BR."AliasName" AS "Empresa",
    JH."TransType" AS "BaseTransType",
    JH."CreatedBy" AS "CreatedBy",
    DH."Number" AS "DocNum",
    'LC' AS "TipoDocumento",
    BP."CardCode" AS "CodPN",
    BP."CardName" AS "PN",
    BP."U_UPPTaxId" AS "CodigoPN",
    JH."U_UPP_CodigoParcelaContrato" AS "Contrato",
    SO."NumAtCard" AS "PV",
    JH."TransId" AS "LCM",
    JH."Number" AS "LCMInterno",
    PVPC."U_UPP_NumeroParcela" AS "NumeroParcela",
    DH."RefDate" AS "RefDate",
    JL."DueDate" AS "DueDate",
    JL."TaxDate" AS "TaxDate",
    JL."Debit" AS "DebitRaw",
    JL."Credit" AS "CreditRaw",
    DRH."ReconNum" AS "ReconNum",
    DRL."ReconSum" AS "ReconSumRaw",
    DRL."IsCredit" AS "ReconIsCredit",
    DRH."ReconDate" AS "ReconDate",
    JL."LineMemo" AS "LineMemo",
    JL."Ref1" AS "Ref1",
    JL."Ref2" AS "Ref2",
    JL."Ref3Line" AS "Ref3Line",
    JH."CreateDate" AS "CreateDate",
    JH."CreateTime" AS "CreateTimeRaw",
    USR."U_NAME" AS "CriadoPor",
    JL."ContraAct" AS "ContraAct",
    CA."AcctName" AS "ContraAcctName",
    CBP."CardName" AS "ContraCardName"
FROM OJDT JH
INNER JOIN JDT1 JL ON JH."TransId" = JL."TransId"
INNER JOIN OCRD BP ON JL."ShortName" = BP."CardCode"
LEFT JOIN OBPL BR ON JL."BPLId" = BR."BPLId"

LEFT JOIN ITR1 BRL
    ON JH."TransId" = BRL."TransId" AND JL."Line_ID" = BRL."TransRowId"
LEFT JOIN OITR BRH
    ON BRL."ReconNum" = BRH."ReconNum" AND BRH."Canceled" = 'N'
LEFT JOIN OACT CA ON JL."ContraAct" = CA."AcctCode"
LEFT JOIN OCRD CBP ON JL."ContraAct" = CBP."CardCode"
INNER JOIN OJDT DH ON JH."TransType" = DH."ObjType" AND JH."CreatedBy" = DH."TransId"
LEFT JOIN "@UPP_PVPC" PVPC ON DH."U_UPP_CodigoParcelaContrato" = PVPC."Code"
    AND PVPC."U_UPP_Ativo" = 'Y'
LEFT JOIN ORDR SO ON PVPC."U_UPP_DocEntryPedido" = SO."DocEntry"

LEFT JOIN ITR1 DRL
    ON DH."TransId" = DRL."TransId" AND JL."Line_ID" = DRL."TransRowId"
LEFT JOIN OITR DRH
    ON DRL."ReconNum" = DRH."ReconNum" AND DRH."Canceled" = 'N'
LEFT JOIN OUSR USR ON JH."UserSign" = USR."USERID"
WHERE BP."CardType" = 'C' AND JH."TransType" = '30'
    AND (BRL."ReconNum" IS NULL OR BRH."ReconNum" IS NOT NULL OR (
        NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM ITR1 BRVL
            INNER JOIN OITR BRVH ON BRVL."ReconNum" = BRVH."ReconNum"
            WHERE BRVL."TransId" = JH."TransId"
                AND BRVL."TransRowId" = JL."Line_ID"
                
                AND BRVH."Canceled" = 'N'
        )
        AND NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM ITR1 BRCL
            WHERE BRCL."TransId" = JH."TransId"
                AND BRCL."TransRowId" = JL."Line_ID"
                
                AND BRCL."ReconNum" < BRL."ReconNum"
        )
    ))
    AND (DRL."ReconNum" IS NULL OR DRH."ReconNum" IS NOT NULL OR (
        NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM ITR1 DRVL
            INNER JOIN OITR DRVH ON DRVL."ReconNum" = DRVH."ReconNum"
            WHERE DRVL."TransId" = DH."TransId"
                AND DRVL."TransRowId" = JL."Line_ID"
                
                AND DRVH."Canceled" = 'N'
        )
        AND NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM ITR1 DRCL
            WHERE DRCL."TransId" = DH."TransId"
                AND DRCL."TransRowId" = JL."Line_ID"
                
                AND DRCL."ReconNum" < DRL."ReconNum"
        )
    ))
    AND JL."BPLId" >= :bplIdInicial AND JL."BPLId" <= :bplIdFinal
    AND DH."RefDate" >= :refDateInicial AND DH."RefDate" <= :refDateFinal
    AND JL."DueDate" >= :dueDateInicial AND JL."DueDate" <= :dueDateFinal
AND (BP."CardCode" IN (:c0, :c1, :c2, :c3, :c4, :c5, :c6, :c7, :c8, :c9, :c10, :c11, :c12, :c13, :c14, :c15, :c16, :c17, :c18, :c19, :c20, :c21, :c22, :c23, :c24) OR (BP."CardCode" >= :clienteInicial AND BP."CardCode" <= :clienteFinal))

SELECT
    JL."BPLId" AS "BPLId",
    BR."BPLName" AS "BPLName",
    BR."AliasName" AS "Empresa",
    JH."TransType" AS "BaseTransType",
    JH."CreatedBy" AS "CreatedBy",
    INV."DocNum" AS "DocNum",
    'NS' AS "TipoDocumento",
    BP."CardCode" AS "CodPN",
    BP."CardName" AS "PN",
    BP."U_UPPTaxId" AS "CodigoPN",
    JH."U_UPP_CodigoParcelaContrato" AS "Contrato",
    INV."NumAtCard" AS "PV",
    JH."TransId" AS "LCM",
    JH."Number" AS "LCMInterno",
    PVPC."U_UPP_NumeroParcela" AS "NumeroParcela",
    JL."RefDate" AS "RefDate",
    JL."DueDate" AS "DueDate",
    JL."TaxDate" AS "TaxDate",
    JL."Debit" AS "DebitRaw",
    JL."Credit" AS "CreditRaw",
    BRH."ReconNum" AS "ReconNum",
    BRL."ReconSum" AS "ReconSumRaw",
    BRL."IsCredit" AS "ReconIsCredit",
    BRH."ReconDate" AS "ReconDate",
    JL."LineMemo" AS "LineMemo",
    JL."Ref1" AS "Ref1",
    JL."Ref2" AS "Ref2",
    JL."Ref3Line" AS "Ref3Line",
    JH."CreateDate" AS "CreateDate",
    JH."CreateTime" AS "CreateTimeRaw",
    USR."U_NAME" AS "CriadoPor",
    JL."ContraAct" AS "ContraAct",
    CA."AcctName" AS "ContraAcctName",
    CBP."CardName" AS "ContraCardName"
FROM OJDT JH
INNER JOIN JDT1 JL ON JH."TransId" = JL."TransId"
INNER JOIN OCRD BP ON JL."ShortName" = BP."CardCode"
LEFT JOIN OBPL BR ON JL."BPLId" = BR."BPLId"

LEFT JOIN ITR1 BRL
    ON JH."TransId" = BRL."TransId" AND JL."Line_ID" = BRL."TransRowId"
LEFT JOIN OITR BRH
    ON BRL."ReconNum" = BRH."ReconNum" AND BRH."Canceled" = 'N'
LEFT JOIN OACT CA ON JL."ContraAct" = CA."AcctCode"
LEFT JOIN OCRD CBP ON JL."ContraAct" = CBP."CardCode"
INNER JOIN OINV INV ON JH."TransType" = INV."ObjType" AND JH."CreatedBy" = INV."DocEntry"
LEFT JOIN INV1 IL ON INV."DocEntry" = IL."DocEntry"
LEFT JOIN RDR1 SOL ON IL."BaseType" = SOL."ObjType" AND IL."BaseEntry" = SOL."DocEntry"
LEFT JOIN ORDR SO ON SOL."DocEntry" = SO."DocEntry" AND INV."NumAtCard" = SO."NumAtCard"
LEFT JOIN "@UPP_PVPC" PVPC ON SO."DocEntry" = PVPC."U_UPP_DocEntryPedido"
    AND PVPC."U_UPP_NumeroParcela" = JL."SourceLine" AND PVPC."U_UPP_Ativo" = 'Y'
LEFT JOIN OUSR USR ON JH."UserSign" = USR."USERID"
WHERE BP."CardType" = 'C' AND JH."TransType" = '13'
    AND (BRL."ReconNum" IS NULL OR BRH."ReconNum" IS NOT NULL OR (
        NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM ITR1 BRVL
            INNER JOIN OITR BRVH ON BRVL."ReconNum" = BRVH."ReconNum"
            WHERE BRVL."TransId" = JH."TransId"
                AND BRVL."TransRowId" = JL."Line_ID"
                
                AND BRVH."Canceled" = 'N'
        )
        AND NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM ITR1 BRCL
            WHERE BRCL."TransId" = JH."TransId"
                AND BRCL."TransRowId" = JL."Line_ID"
                
                AND BRCL."ReconNum" < BRL."ReconNum"
        )
    ))
    AND JL."BPLId" >= :bplIdInicial AND JL."BPLId" <= :bplIdFinal
    AND JL."RefDate" >= :refDateInicial AND JL."RefDate" <= :refDateFinal
    AND JL."DueDate" >= :dueDateInicial AND JL."DueDate" <= :dueDateFinal
AND (BP."CardCode" IN (:c0, :c1, :c2, :c3, :c4, :c5, :c6, :c7, :c8, :c9, :c10, :c11, :c12, :c13, :c14, :c15, :c16, :c17, :c18, :c19, :c20, :c21, :c22, :c23, :c24) OR (BP."CardCode" >= :clienteInicial AND BP."CardCode" <= :clienteFinal))

SELECT
    JL."BPLId" AS "BPLId",
    BR."BPLName" AS "BPLName",
    BR."AliasName" AS "Empresa",
    JH."TransType" AS "BaseTransType",
    JH."CreatedBy" AS "CreatedBy",
    PAY."DocNum" AS "DocNum",
    'CR' AS "TipoDocumento",
    BP."CardCode" AS "CodPN",
    BP."CardName" AS "PN",
    BP."U_UPPTaxId" AS "CodigoPN",
    JH."U_UPP_CodigoParcelaContrato" AS "Contrato",
    '' AS "PV",
    JH."TransId" AS "LCM",
    JH."Number" AS "LCMInterno",
    '0' AS "NumeroParcela",
    JL."RefDate" AS "RefDate",
    JL."DueDate" AS "DueDate",
    JL."TaxDate" AS "TaxDate",
    JL."Debit" AS "DebitRaw",
    JL."Credit" AS "CreditRaw",
    BRH."ReconNum" AS "ReconNum",
    BRL."ReconSum" AS "ReconSumRaw",
    BRL."IsCredit" AS "ReconIsCredit",
    BRH."ReconDate" AS "ReconDate",
    JL."LineMemo" AS "LineMemo",
    JL."Ref1" AS "Ref1",
    JL."Ref2" AS "Ref2",
    JL."Ref3Line" AS "Ref3Line",
    JH."CreateDate" AS "CreateDate",
    JH."CreateTime" AS "CreateTimeRaw",
    USR."U_NAME" AS "CriadoPor",
    JL."ContraAct" AS "ContraAct",
    CA."AcctName" AS "ContraAcctName",
    CBP."CardName" AS "ContraCardName", PAY."U_UPP_CodigoParcelaContrato" AS "PaymentContrato"
FROM OJDT JH
INNER JOIN JDT1 JL ON JH."TransId" = JL."TransId"
INNER JOIN OCRD BP ON JL."ShortName" = BP."CardCode"
LEFT JOIN OBPL BR ON JL."BPLId" = BR."BPLId"

LEFT JOIN ITR1 BRL
    ON JH."TransId" = BRL."TransId" AND JL."Line_ID" = BRL."TransRowId"
LEFT JOIN OITR BRH
    ON BRL."ReconNum" = BRH."ReconNum" AND BRH."Canceled" = 'N'
LEFT JOIN OACT CA ON JL."ContraAct" = CA."AcctCode"
LEFT JOIN OCRD CBP ON JL."ContraAct" = CBP."CardCode"
LEFT JOIN ORCT PAY ON JH."TransType" = PAY."ObjType" AND JH."CreatedBy" = PAY."DocEntry"
LEFT JOIN OUSR USR ON JH."UserSign" = USR."USERID"
WHERE BP."CardType" = 'C' AND JH."TransType" = '24'
    AND (BRL."ReconNum" IS NULL OR BRH."ReconNum" IS NOT NULL OR (
        NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM ITR1 BRVL
            INNER JOIN OITR BRVH ON BRVL."ReconNum" = BRVH."ReconNum"
            WHERE BRVL."TransId" = JH."TransId"
                AND BRVL."TransRowId" = JL."Line_ID"
                
                AND BRVH."Canceled" = 'N'
        )
        AND NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM ITR1 BRCL
            WHERE BRCL."TransId" = JH."TransId"
                AND BRCL."TransRowId" = JL."Line_ID"
                
                AND BRCL."ReconNum" < BRL."ReconNum"
        )
    ))
    AND JL."BPLId" >= :bplIdInicial AND JL."BPLId" <= :bplIdFinal
    AND JL."RefDate" >= :refDateInicial AND JL."RefDate" <= :refDateFinal
    AND JL."DueDate" >= :dueDateInicial AND JL."DueDate" <= :dueDateFinal
AND (BP."CardCode" IN (:c0, :c1, :c2, :c3, :c4, :c5, :c6, :c7, :c8, :c9, :c10, :c11, :c12, :c13, :c14, :c15, :c16, :c17, :c18, :c19, :c20, :c21, :c22, :c23, :c24) OR (BP."CardCode" >= :clienteInicial AND BP."CardCode" <= :clienteFinal))

SELECT
    JL."BPLId" AS "BPLId",
    BR."BPLName" AS "BPLName",
    BR."AliasName" AS "Empresa",
    JH."TransType" AS "BaseTransType",
    JH."CreatedBy" AS "CreatedBy",
    DH."Number" AS "DocNum",
    'RI' AS "TipoDocumento",
    BP."CardCode" AS "CodPN",
    BP."CardName" AS "PN",
    BP."U_UPPTaxId" AS "CodigoPN",
    JH."U_UPP_CodigoParcelaContrato" AS "Contrato",
    SO."NumAtCard" AS "PV",
    JH."TransId" AS "LCM",
    JH."Number" AS "LCMInterno",
    PVPC."U_UPP_NumeroParcela" AS "NumeroParcela",
    DH."RefDate" AS "RefDate",
    JL."DueDate" AS "DueDate",
    JL."TaxDate" AS "TaxDate",
    JL."Debit" AS "DebitRaw",
    JL."Credit" AS "CreditRaw",
    DRH."ReconNum" AS "ReconNum",
    DRL."ReconSum" AS "ReconSumRaw",
    DRL."IsCredit" AS "ReconIsCredit",
    DRH."ReconDate" AS "ReconDate",
    JL."LineMemo" AS "LineMemo",
    JL."Ref1" AS "Ref1",
    JL."Ref2" AS "Ref2",
    JL."Ref3Line" AS "Ref3Line",
    JH."CreateDate" AS "CreateDate",
    JH."CreateTime" AS "CreateTimeRaw",
    USR."U_NAME" AS "CriadoPor",
    JL."ContraAct" AS "ContraAct",
    CA."AcctName" AS "ContraAcctName",
    CBP."CardName" AS "ContraCardName"
FROM OJDT JH
INNER JOIN JDT1 JL ON JH."TransId" = JL."TransId"
INNER JOIN OCRD BP ON JL."ShortName" = BP."CardCode"
LEFT JOIN OBPL BR ON JL."BPLId" = BR."BPLId"

LEFT JOIN ITR1 BRL
    ON JH."TransId" = BRL."TransId" AND JL."Line_ID" = BRL."TransRowId"
LEFT JOIN OITR BRH
    ON BRL."ReconNum" = BRH."ReconNum" AND BRH."Canceled" = 'N'
LEFT JOIN OACT CA ON JL."ContraAct" = CA."AcctCode"
LEFT JOIN OCRD CBP ON JL."ContraAct" = CBP."CardCode"
INNER JOIN OJDT DH ON JH."TransType" = DH."TransType" AND JH."TransId" = DH."TransId"
LEFT JOIN "@UPP_PVPC" PVPC ON DH."U_UPP_CodigoParcelaContrato" = PVPC."Code"
    AND PVPC."U_UPP_Ativo" = 'Y'
LEFT JOIN ORDR SO ON PVPC."U_UPP_DocEntryPedido" = SO."DocEntry"

LEFT JOIN ITR1 DRL
    ON DH."TransId" = DRL."TransId" AND JL."Line_ID" = DRL."TransRowId" AND JH."CreatedBy" = DRL."ReconNum"
LEFT JOIN OITR DRH
    ON DRL."ReconNum" = DRH."ReconNum" AND DRH."Canceled" = 'N'
LEFT JOIN OUSR USR ON JH."UserSign" = USR."USERID"
WHERE BP."CardType" = 'C' AND JH."TransType" = '321'
    AND (BRL."ReconNum" IS NULL OR BRH."ReconNum" IS NOT NULL OR (
        NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM ITR1 BRVL
            INNER JOIN OITR BRVH ON BRVL."ReconNum" = BRVH."ReconNum"
            WHERE BRVL."TransId" = JH."TransId"
                AND BRVL."TransRowId" = JL."Line_ID"
                
                AND BRVH."Canceled" = 'N'
        )
        AND NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM ITR1 BRCL
            WHERE BRCL."TransId" = JH."TransId"
                AND BRCL."TransRowId" = JL."Line_ID"
                
                AND BRCL."ReconNum" < BRL."ReconNum"
        )
    ))
    AND (DRL."ReconNum" IS NULL OR DRH."ReconNum" IS NOT NULL OR (
        NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM ITR1 DRVL
            INNER JOIN OITR DRVH ON DRVL."ReconNum" = DRVH."ReconNum"
            WHERE DRVL."TransId" = DH."TransId"
                AND DRVL."TransRowId" = JL."Line_ID"
                
                AND DRVL."ReconNum" = JH."CreatedBy"
                AND DRVH."Canceled" = 'N'
        )
        AND NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM ITR1 DRCL
            WHERE DRCL."TransId" = DH."TransId"
                AND DRCL."TransRowId" = JL."Line_ID"
                
                AND DRCL."ReconNum" = JH."CreatedBy"
                AND DRCL."ReconNum" < DRL."ReconNum"
        )
    ))
    AND JL."BPLId" >= :bplIdInicial AND JL."BPLId" <= :bplIdFinal
    AND DH."RefDate" >= :refDateInicial AND DH."RefDate" <= :refDateFinal
    AND JL."DueDate" >= :dueDateInicial AND JL."DueDate" <= :dueDateFinal
AND (BP."CardCode" IN (:c0, :c1, :c2, :c3, :c4, :c5, :c6, :c7, :c8, :c9, :c10, :c11, :c12, :c13, :c14, :c15, :c16, :c17, :c18, :c19, :c20, :c21, :c22, :c23, :c24) OR (BP."CardCode" >= :clienteInicial AND BP."CardCode" <= :clienteFinal))

SELECT
    JL."BPLId" AS "BPLId", BR."BPLName" AS "BPLName", BR."AliasName" AS "Empresa",
    JH."Number" AS "DocNum", BP."CardCode" AS "CodPN", BP."CardName" AS "PN",
    BP."U_UPPTaxId" AS "CodigoPN", JH."TransId" AS "LCM",
    JL."RefDate" AS "RefDate", JL."DueDate" AS "DueDate", JL."TaxDate" AS "TaxDate",
    JL."Debit" AS "DebitRaw", JL."Credit" AS "CreditRaw",
    JL."LineMemo" AS "LineMemo", JL."Ref1" AS "Ref1", JL."Ref2" AS "Ref2",
    JL."Ref3Line" AS "Ref3Line", JH."CreateDate" AS "CreateDate",
    JH."CreateTime" AS "CreateTimeRaw", JH."UserSign" AS "UserSignGroup",
    USR."U_NAME" AS "CriadoPor", JL."ContraAct" AS "ContraAct",
    CA."AcctName" AS "ContraAcctName", CBP."CardName" AS "ContraCardName"
FROM OJDT JH
INNER JOIN JDT1 JL ON JH."TransId" = JL."TransId"
INNER JOIN OCRD BP ON JL."ContraAct" = BP."CardCode"
LEFT JOIN OBPL BR ON JL."BPLId" = BR."BPLId"
LEFT JOIN OACT CA ON JL."ContraAct" = CA."AcctCode"
LEFT JOIN OCRD CBP ON JL."ContraAct" = CBP."CardCode"
LEFT JOIN OUSR USR ON JH."UserSign" = USR."USERID"
WHERE JL."Account" = '2.1.10.01.001'
    AND JL."BPLId" >= :bplIdInicial AND JL."BPLId" <= :bplIdFinal
    AND JL."RefDate" >= :refDateInicial AND JL."RefDate" <= :refDateFinal
    AND JL."DueDate" >= :dueDateInicial AND JL."DueDate" <= :dueDateFinal
AND (BP."CardCode" IN (:c0, :c1, :c2, :c3, :c4, :c5, :c6, :c7, :c8, :c9, :c10, :c11, :c12, :c13, :c14, :c15, :c16, :c17, :c18, :c19, :c20, :c21, :c22, :c23, :c24) OR (BP."CardCode" >= :clienteInicial AND BP."CardCode" <= :clienteFinal))

SELECT
    AJL."BPLId" AS "BPLId", ABR."BPLName" AS "BPLName", ABR."AliasName" AS "Empresa",
    JH."TransType" AS "BaseTransType", AJH."Number" AS "DocNum",
    ABP."CardCode" AS "CodPN", ABP."CardName" AS "PN",
    ABP."U_UPPTaxId" AS "CodigoPN", JH."TransId" AS "LCM",
    JH."Number" AS "LCMInterno", AJL."RefDate" AS "RefDate",
    JL."DueDate" AS "DueDate", JL."TaxDate" AS "TaxDate",
    AJL."Debit" AS "DebitRaw", AJL."Credit" AS "CreditRaw",
    ARH."ReconNum" AS "ReconNum", ARL."ReconSum" AS "ReconSumRaw",
    ARL."IsCredit" AS "ReconIsCredit", ARH."ReconDate" AS "ReconDate",
    JL."LineMemo" AS "LineMemo", AJL."Ref1" AS "Ref1", AJL."Ref2" AS "Ref2",
    AJL."Ref3Line" AS "Ref3Line", JH."CreateDate" AS "CreateDate",
    JH."CreateTime" AS "CreateTimeRaw", JH."UserSign" AS "UserSignGroup",
    USR."U_NAME" AS "CriadoPor", 'JU-LCM' AS "TipoDocumento"

FROM OJDT JH
INNER JOIN JDT1 JL ON JH."TransId" = JL."TransId"
INNER JOIN OCRD BP ON JL."ShortName" = BP."CardCode"
LEFT JOIN OBPL BR ON JL."BPLId" = BR."BPLId"

LEFT JOIN ITR1 BRL
    ON JH."TransId" = BRL."TransId" AND JL."Line_ID" = BRL."TransRowId"
LEFT JOIN OITR BRH
    ON BRL."ReconNum" = BRH."ReconNum" AND BRH."Canceled" = 'N'
LEFT JOIN OACT CA ON JL."ContraAct" = CA."AcctCode"
LEFT JOIN OCRD CBP ON JL."ContraAct" = CBP."CardCode"
INNER JOIN JDT1 AJL ON JH."TransId" = AJL."TransId"
    AND AJL."Account" = (SELECT TOP 1 PP."OverpayAR" FROM OACP PP ORDER BY PP."AbsEntry" DESC)
LEFT JOIN OJDT AJH ON AJL."TransId" = AJH."TransId"
LEFT JOIN OCRD ABP ON AJL."ContraAct" = ABP."CardCode"
LEFT JOIN OBPL ABR ON AJL."BPLId" = ABR."BPLId"

LEFT JOIN ITR1 ARL
    ON AJL."TransId" = ARL."TransId" AND AJL."Line_ID" = ARL."TransRowId"
LEFT JOIN OITR ARH
    ON ARL."ReconNum" = ARH."ReconNum" AND ARH."Canceled" = 'N'
LEFT JOIN OUSR USR ON JH."UserSign" = USR."USERID"
WHERE BP."CardType" = 'C'
    AND (BRL."ReconNum" IS NULL OR BRH."ReconNum" IS NOT NULL OR (
        NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM ITR1 BRVL
            INNER JOIN OITR BRVH ON BRVL."ReconNum" = BRVH."ReconNum"
            WHERE BRVL."TransId" = JH."TransId"
                AND BRVL."TransRowId" = JL."Line_ID"
                
                AND BRVH."Canceled" = 'N'
        )
        AND NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM ITR1 BRCL
            WHERE BRCL."TransId" = JH."TransId"
                AND BRCL."TransRowId" = JL."Line_ID"
                
                AND BRCL."ReconNum" < BRL."ReconNum"
        )
    ))
    AND (ARL."ReconNum" IS NULL OR ARH."ReconNum" IS NOT NULL OR (
        NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM ITR1 ARVL
            INNER JOIN OITR ARVH ON ARVL."ReconNum" = ARVH."ReconNum"
            WHERE ARVL."TransId" = AJL."TransId"
                AND ARVL."TransRowId" = AJL."Line_ID"
                
                AND ARVH."Canceled" = 'N'
        )
        AND NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM ITR1 ARCL
            WHERE ARCL."TransId" = AJL."TransId"
                AND ARCL."TransRowId" = AJL."Line_ID"
                
                AND ARCL."ReconNum" < ARL."ReconNum"
        )
    ))
    AND AJL."BPLId" >= :bplIdInicial AND AJL."BPLId" <= :bplIdFinal
    AND AJL."RefDate" >= :refDateInicial AND AJL."RefDate" <= :refDateFinal
    AND JL."DueDate" >= :dueDateInicial AND JL."DueDate" <= :dueDateFinal
AND (ABP."CardCode" IN (:c0, :c1, :c2, :c3, :c4, :c5, :c6, :c7, :c8, :c9, :c10, :c11, :c12, :c13, :c14, :c15, :c16, :c17, :c18, :c19, :c20, :c21, :c22, :c23, :c24) OR (ABP."CardCode" >= :clienteInicial AND ABP."CardCode" <= :clienteFinal))

SELECT
    AJL."BPLId" AS "BPLId", ABR."BPLName" AS "BPLName", ABR."AliasName" AS "Empresa",
    JH."TransType" AS "BaseTransType", AJH."Number" AS "DocNum",
    ABP."CardCode" AS "CodPN", ABP."CardName" AS "PN",
    ABP."U_UPPTaxId" AS "CodigoPN", JH."TransId" AS "LCM",
    JH."Number" AS "LCMInterno", AJL."RefDate" AS "RefDate",
    JL."DueDate" AS "DueDate", JL."TaxDate" AS "TaxDate",
    AJL."Debit" AS "DebitRaw", AJL."Credit" AS "CreditRaw",
    ARH."ReconNum" AS "ReconNum", ARL."ReconSum" AS "ReconSumRaw",
    ARL."IsCredit" AS "ReconIsCredit", ARH."ReconDate" AS "ReconDate",
    JL."LineMemo" AS "LineMemo", AJL."Ref1" AS "Ref1", AJL."Ref2" AS "Ref2",
    AJL."Ref3Line" AS "Ref3Line", JH."CreateDate" AS "CreateDate",
    JH."CreateTime" AS "CreateTimeRaw", JH."UserSign" AS "UserSignGroup",
    USR."U_NAME" AS "CriadoPor", 'DS-LCM' AS "TipoDocumento"

FROM OJDT JH
INNER JOIN JDT1 JL ON JH."TransId" = JL."TransId"
INNER JOIN OCRD BP ON JL."ShortName" = BP."CardCode"
LEFT JOIN OBPL BR ON JL."BPLId" = BR."BPLId"

LEFT JOIN ITR1 BRL
    ON JH."TransId" = BRL."TransId" AND JL."Line_ID" = BRL."TransRowId"
LEFT JOIN OITR BRH
    ON BRL."ReconNum" = BRH."ReconNum" AND BRH."Canceled" = 'N'
LEFT JOIN OACT CA ON JL."ContraAct" = CA."AcctCode"
LEFT JOIN OCRD CBP ON JL."ContraAct" = CBP."CardCode"
INNER JOIN JDT1 AJL ON JH."TransId" = AJL."TransId"
    AND AJL."Account" = (SELECT TOP 1 PP."UndrpayAR" FROM OACP PP ORDER BY PP."AbsEntry" DESC)
LEFT JOIN OJDT AJH ON AJL."TransId" = AJH."TransId"
LEFT JOIN OCRD ABP ON AJL."ContraAct" = ABP."CardCode"
LEFT JOIN OBPL ABR ON AJL."BPLId" = ABR."BPLId"

LEFT JOIN ITR1 ARL
    ON AJL."TransId" = ARL."TransId" AND AJL."Line_ID" = ARL."TransRowId"
LEFT JOIN OITR ARH
    ON ARL."ReconNum" = ARH."ReconNum" AND ARH."Canceled" = 'N'
LEFT JOIN OUSR USR ON JH."UserSign" = USR."USERID"
WHERE BP."CardType" = 'C'
    AND (BRL."ReconNum" IS NULL OR BRH."ReconNum" IS NOT NULL OR (
        NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM ITR1 BRVL
            INNER JOIN OITR BRVH ON BRVL."ReconNum" = BRVH."ReconNum"
            WHERE BRVL."TransId" = JH."TransId"
                AND BRVL."TransRowId" = JL."Line_ID"
                
                AND BRVH."Canceled" = 'N'
        )
        AND NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM ITR1 BRCL
            WHERE BRCL."TransId" = JH."TransId"
                AND BRCL."TransRowId" = JL."Line_ID"
                
                AND BRCL."ReconNum" < BRL."ReconNum"
        )
    ))
    AND (ARL."ReconNum" IS NULL OR ARH."ReconNum" IS NOT NULL OR (
        NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM ITR1 ARVL
            INNER JOIN OITR ARVH ON ARVL."ReconNum" = ARVH."ReconNum"
            WHERE ARVL."TransId" = AJL."TransId"
                AND ARVL."TransRowId" = AJL."Line_ID"
                
                AND ARVH."Canceled" = 'N'
        )
        AND NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM ITR1 ARCL
            WHERE ARCL."TransId" = AJL."TransId"
                AND ARCL."TransRowId" = AJL."Line_ID"
                
                AND ARCL."ReconNum" < ARL."ReconNum"
        )
    ))
    AND AJL."BPLId" >= :bplIdInicial AND AJL."BPLId" <= :bplIdFinal
    AND AJL."RefDate" >= :refDateInicial AND AJL."RefDate" <= :refDateFinal
    AND JL."DueDate" >= :dueDateInicial AND JL."DueDate" <= :dueDateFinal
AND (ABP."CardCode" IN (:c0, :c1, :c2, :c3, :c4, :c5, :c6, :c7, :c8, :c9, :c10, :c11, :c12, :c13, :c14, :c15, :c16, :c17, :c18, :c19, :c20, :c21, :c22, :c23, :c24) OR (ABP."CardCode" >= :clienteInicial AND ABP."CardCode" <= :clienteFinal))
